tasks.title: Add the pure settle rule and the photo panel controller
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_stops_test.dart` and `photo_panel_controller_test.dart` pass: settle picks the nearest stop, a flick moves exactly one stop past the start stop, any leftward drag from closed gives at least half-open, and only one photo is ever selected (same photo again clears, another moves, close clears, a vanished photo clears).

tasks.title: Derive the current session's photos with words
tasks.dod: `photos_with_words_test.dart` passes: only photo sources of the current session with at least one linked row are listed, in `Session.sources` order, with their row ids; a typed, Quizlet-only or emptied session gives an empty list; deleting a photo's last row or clearing its word removes it at once.

tasks.title: Keep the photo tab's height and the review-only design variant in preferences
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_prefs_test.dart` passes: `photo_tab_top` is read back after a restart, the first default sits beside the first word rows, a stored value is clamped between the top bar and the floating-button row, and a failed write of `photo_panel_variant` keeps the chosen variant in memory.

tasks.title: Add the gesture exclusion service and its Android channel handler
tasks.dod: `system_gesture_exclusion_test.dart` passes against a mocked `vocab/system_gesture_exclusion` channel (rects sent in physical pixels, empty list clears, platform errors swallowed, no call off Android), and `MainActivity.kt` builds in `flutter build apk --debug`.

tasks.title: Show a photo from the kept file at preview size, with a not-available placeholder
tasks.dod: `photo_preview_test.dart` passes: a readable source decodes with `cacheWidth` = width × device pixel ratio, and a `null` read or a decode error shows the "not available" placeholder while the other previews still show.

tasks.title: Define the PhotoPanelLook interface and build look A
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_look_test.dart` passes: look A is returned for variant `a`, its tab is at most 200 dp tall (the interface assertion fires for a taller test look), it draws at most three mini previews plus the count, and its row highlight is non-null while `WordRowItem` with no highlight is unchanged.

tasks.title: Draw the photo tab in an overlay and let it be dragged up or down
tasks.dod: `photo_tab_position_test.dart` passes: no photo with words draws nothing; the tab sits beside the first rows, then at the kept height after a vertical drag and a restart; it stays put while the list scrolls; it rides above the keyboard and returns; it stays between the top bar and the floating buttons (and above a SnackBar); a touch while busy is ignored.

tasks.title: Open the panel half-open and full-open, settle at stops, and step back
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_open_test.dart` passes: a tap settles half-open within `pump(300 ms)` with no animation running and the small photos oldest first; a short left drag gives half-open, a longer one full-open, a flick one stop further; the expand control opens full-open; a drag back on the handle settles by the rule; `stepBack()` goes full-open → half-open → closed; opening unfocuses the field and keeps its text.

tasks.title: Show the large photos in full-open with zoom and neighbour-only decoding
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_full_open_test.dart` passes: full-open starts at the selected photo (or the first), a two-finger scale zooms with `InteractiveViewer`, a drag on a zoomed photo pans it and does not move the panel, browsing does not change the selected photo, a tap on a large photo does nothing, only the shown photo and its neighbours are decoded, and an unreadable photo shows the placeholder.

tasks.title: Send the tab or handle rectangle to the gesture exclusion service at every change
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_exclusion_test.dart` passes against the mocked channel: closed sends the tab's on-screen rectangle after every layout and move, half-open sends the handle, full-open, the drawer open and no tab send an empty list, and the last call always matches what is on screen.

tasks.title: Make every panel state reachable and closable with a screen reader
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_semantics_test.dart` passes with `tester.ensureSemantics()`: the tab is one node labelled "Session photos, N" whose tap action opens half-open (ignored while busy), each small photo is a selectable button, labelled expand, close and back-to-half-open buttons exist, and every state is reached and left without a drag.

tasks.title: Give the word list a ScrollController, row keys, a row highlight and the jump to a row
tasks.dod: `row_jump_test.dart` passes with 200 rows of mixed heights: after the jump and `pump(500 ms)` the first linked row (in the list's current order) is fully in view, an already visible row does not move, both the normal and the drag-mode list scroll; `word_row_layout_test.dart` and `app_smoke_test.dart` stay green unchanged with no highlight.

tasks.title: Mount the photo panel on the main screen with Back stepping, highlight and jump
tasks.dod: `main_screen_photo_panel_test.dart` passes on the real `WordInputScreen`: a session with photos shows the tab; selecting a photo highlights all its rows and jumps to the first; another tap moves or clears it without scrolling; scrolling keeps half-open and the highlight; Back steps full-open → half-open → closed and leaves only when closed; a session with no photo with words has no `PopScope` interception and looks as today; deleting the selected photo's last row clears the selection.

tasks.title: Make an open panel own the main screen's touches and close on a session change
tasks.dod: `main_screen_photo_panel_test.dart` passes the new cases: with the panel open a tap on a row, the top bar, its menu or the floating buttons only closes it (no focus, no handler, no route), the visible list still scrolls in half-open, the drawer does not open and the tab is hidden while the drawer is open, a new current session id closes the panel and clears the selection, pushing another route closes it first, a background/resume with the same session keeps stop and selection, and the tab ignores touches while busy.

tasks.title: Keep the tab on every pager page and open the panel only over the words page
tasks.dod: `photo_panel_pager_test.dart` passes on a session with dialogues: a drag on the tab on the words page leaves `PageController.page` unchanged; opening from a dialogue page first animates to page 0 then settles; while open no swipe changes the page; while closed a swipe away from the tab changes the page; the tab does not move with a page swipe.

tasks.dod: `photo_panel_look_test.dart` passes for look C (variant `c` maps to it, tab ≤ 200 dp, highlight non-null), and the full behaviour suite of T19 passes with it.
